title: The menu link Google Maps lists for a place reaches the profile's menus as a Maps link, https only
steps: S1: Run the package suite for the SerpApi place lookup's menu link (stubbed SerpApi answer).
S2: Run the tracy-web Google Maps research suite against Postgres with a stubbed place answer that lists a SinglePlatform menu link.
expect: S1: the suite passes; a listed https menu link comes back as menuLink {url, source}, none gives null, and a non-https or credentialed link is dropped.
S2: the suite passes; the google-maps source holds the menuLink and the snapshot profile's menus hold that url exactly once with source google-maps.
fence: Google Maps menu link in the place profile
